name: AWS
description: Manage Amazon Web Services resources including S3, EC2, Lambda, and more through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredEnv.label: AWS Access Key ID
requiredEnv.help: The access key ID from your AWS IAM credentials

requiredEnv.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredEnv.label: AWS Secret Access Key
requiredEnv.help: The secret access key paired with your access key ID

requiredEnv.name: AWS_REGION
requiredEnv.label: AWS Region
requiredEnv.help: The default AWS region to use (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1)

name: Microsoft Azure
description: Manage Azure resources including VMs, Storage, and App Services through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
requiredEnv.label: Azure Subscription ID
requiredEnv.help: Your Azure subscription ID (found in the Azure Portal under Subscriptions)

requiredEnv.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
requiredEnv.label: Azure Tenant ID
requiredEnv.help: Your Azure Active Directory tenant ID

requiredEnv.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
requiredEnv.label: Azure Client ID
requiredEnv.help: The application (client) ID of your Azure AD app registration

requiredEnv.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
requiredEnv.label: Azure Client Secret
requiredEnv.help: A client secret generated for your Azure AD app registration

name: Bitbucket
description: Access Bitbucket repositories, pull requests, and pipelines through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: BITBUCKET_USERNAME
requiredEnv.label: Bitbucket Username
requiredEnv.help: Your Bitbucket Cloud username (not email)

requiredEnv.name: BITBUCKET_APP_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.label: Bitbucket App Password
requiredEnv.help: An app password with repository and pull request permissions

name: Brave Search
description: Perform web searches using the Brave Search API through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
requiredEnv.label: Brave Search API Key
requiredEnv.help: An API key from the Brave Search API dashboard

name: Discord
description: Access Discord servers, channels, and messages through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: Discord Bot Token
requiredEnv.help: A bot token from the Discord Developer Portal

name: Dropbox
description: Access and manage Dropbox files and folders through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: Dropbox Access Token
requiredEnv.help: A short-lived or long-lived access token from the Dropbox App Console

name: Elasticsearch
description: Search and manage Elasticsearch indices and documents through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: ELASTICSEARCH_URL
requiredEnv.label: Elasticsearch URL
requiredEnv.help: The base URL of your Elasticsearch cluster (e.g., https://my-cluster.es.us-east-1.aws.found.io:9243)

requiredEnv.name: ELASTICSEARCH_API_KEY
requiredEnv.label: Elasticsearch API Key
requiredEnv.help: An API key with read/write permissions for the target indices

name: Exa Search
description: Perform AI-powered neural searches and retrieve web content through the Exa MCP server

requiredEnv.name: EXA_API_KEY
requiredEnv.label: Exa API Key
requiredEnv.help: An API key from the Exa dashboard

name: Google Cloud Platform
description: Manage GCP resources including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
requiredEnv.label: Service Account Key Path
requiredEnv.help: Absolute path to a GCP service account JSON key file

name: GitHub
description: Access GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and organizations through the official MCP server

requiredEnv.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
requiredEnv.help: A fine-grained or classic PAT with repo and read:org scopes

name: GitLab
description: Access GitLab projects, merge requests, issues, and CI/CD pipelines through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: GitLab Personal Access Token
requiredEnv.help: A personal access token with api scope from your GitLab instance

name: Gmail
description: Read, send, and manage Gmail messages and drafts through the Anthropic MCP server

name: Google Calendar
description: Manage Google Calendar events, schedules, and availability through the Anthropic MCP server

name: Google Drive
description: Browse, search, and read files from Google Drive through the Anthropic MCP server

name: Jira
description: Access Jira issues, projects, boards, and sprints through the Atlassian MCP server

requiredEnv.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: Jira API Token
requiredEnv.help: An API token generated from your Atlassian account

requiredEnv.name: JIRA_INSTANCE_URL
requiredEnv.label: Jira Instance URL
requiredEnv.help: Your Jira Cloud instance URL (e.g., https://yourcompany.atlassian.net)

requiredEnv.name: JIRA_USER_EMAIL
requiredEnv.label: Jira User Email
requiredEnv.help: The email address associated with your Atlassian account

name: Linear
description: Manage Linear issues, projects, cycles, and teams through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: LINEAR_API_KEY
requiredEnv.label: Linear API Key
requiredEnv.help: A personal API key from your Linear account settings

name: MongoDB
description: Query and manage MongoDB databases and collections through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: MONGODB_URI
requiredEnv.label: MongoDB Connection URI
requiredEnv.help: A full MongoDB connection string (e.g., mongodb+srv://user:password@cluster.mongodb.net/dbname)

name: Notion
description: Access and manage Notion pages, databases, and blocks through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: NOTION_API_KEY
requiredEnv.label: Notion Integration Token
requiredEnv.help: An internal integration token created in your Notion workspace settings

name: PostgreSQL
description: Query and manage PostgreSQL databases through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING
requiredEnv.label: PostgreSQL Connection String
requiredEnv.help: A full connection URI (e.g., postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname)

name: Redis
description: Access and manage Redis key-value stores through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: REDIS_URL
requiredEnv.label: Redis Connection URL
requiredEnv.help: A Redis connection URL (e.g., redis://user:password@host:6379/0)

name: Sentry
description: Monitor and manage Sentry error tracking, issues, and releases through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: Sentry Auth Token
requiredEnv.help: An authentication token with project:read and event:read scopes

requiredEnv.name: SENTRY_ORG_SLUG

requiredEnv.help: Your Sentry organization slug (found in Settings > General)

name: Slack
description: Access Slack channels, messages, and users through the MCP server

requiredEnv.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
requiredEnv.label: Slack Bot Token
requiredEnv.help: A bot user OAuth token starting with xoxb-

requiredEnv.name: SLACK_TEAM_ID
requiredEnv.label: Slack Team ID
requiredEnv.help: Your Slack workspace team ID (found in workspace settings or URL)

name: SQLite

requiredEnv.name: SQLITE_DB_PATH
requiredEnv.label: SQLite Database Path
requiredEnv.help: Absolute path to the SQLite database file (e.g., /home/user/data/mydb.sqlite)

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Access Microsoft Teams channels, chats, and messages through the MCP server

name: Todoist

requiredEnv.name: TODOIST_API_KEY
